hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that routes swaps entirely through Euler lending vaults. It computes swap amounts via a configurable bonding curve, handles all token accounting by depositing inputs into and withdrawing outputs from Euler vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass the pool's internal AMM math. Concentrated liquidity positions and donations are intentionally blocked.
